ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Refugee Program
ideas.description: Investigate the financial dealings of Minnesota's refugee program to identify potential fraud and abuse.
questions: What are the financial dealings of Minnesota's refugee program?
Are there any signs of fraud or abuse?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse in Minnesota's refugee program. By following the money, we can identify potential wrongdoing and hold those responsible accountable.
